title: Discovery Room 001 — one inspectable question-to-result loop
question: Does structured receipt exchange improve a bounded computational search task?

protocol_ref.note: Discovery room, not a repro-lab room: no separate PROTOCOL.md. The execution path is the deterministic receiver code backend/world.py (_research_prepare_result / _research_finalize_result), pinned by the repo commit.

participants.description: Internal operator. Posted the research question; funded and started the commission on the simulated ledger.
Internal operator. Deterministic test client, not an AI scientist. Proposed the agreement, submitted through the receiver, delivered the verification report.
Internal operator. Deterministic test client. Attempted agree() as a non-counterpart; refused with WORLD_RULE_NOT_COUNTERPART.
The world's EffectGate receiver. Evaluated presentations, ran the manifest verification, recorded the cost, accepted the result.

authority_note: Room membership grants no spending, execution, or publication authority. The receiver owns acceptance; the room displays frozen records.

badges.schema-valid: The listing disclosure parses and matches the declared disclosure schema; reuse_terms carries the verbatim disclaimer.
badges.receiver-accepted: The gate accepted the agreement submit; the verification result is recorded and gate-signed.
badges.scientifically-supported: NOT EARNED: the frozen protocol's decision rule was not met (C did not beat B). The loop completes on this unfavorable result; the result is preserved, not endorsed.
badges.non_implication: None of these implies the others. A schema-valid artifact may fail receiver acceptance; a receiver-accepted package may make a false claim; a statistically met threshold is not scientific truth.

verdict.primary: One complete loop: question -> agreed contribution -> supported experiment -> result + accounting returned to the question.
verdict.detail: 40/40 artifact hashes match; manifest pin mismatch reported (604fe0d3... vs c4aa89ff...); experiment outcome preserved verbatim: C did not beat B. Spent 4/10 simulated-compute-units on the existing commission ledger.

reuse_terms: Artifacts reusable for verification. No IP transfer. A receipt records an agreement; it does not establish intellectual-property rights or scientific truth.

binding_defect.what: v1 listing (seed_discovery.py) declared the stale manifest pin 604fe0d3... (copied from repro-lab-001 ROOM.json evidence_manifest_sha256, recorded before the manifest was regenerated). The receiver evaluated the real manifest (c4aa89ff...), recorded pin_match:false, but v1 submit settled anyway -- binding was informational, not enforced.

affected.status: documented as affected by the binding defect; preserved, not erased or rewritten

binding_defect.fix: World._research_enforce_manifest_binding: a declared pin that does not exactly equal the evaluated manifest's sha256 now raises RESEARCH_MANIFEST_PIN_MISMATCH before any acceptance or settlement effect.

corrected_loop_v2.verification: 40/40 artifact hashes recomputed and matched, 0 mismatches
